subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on 'A Book Fair You Have Visited'
stimulus: recently by answering the following questions. You should write about 250 words; 10 (a) What is a book fair? (b) What was the occasion of the fair? (c) Where was it held (d) How was the environment of the fair? (e) What experience did you gather by visiting the fair?
